representation: A new dedicated bootstrap loads bootstrap_reactor and bootstrap_development_cycle, then one narrow development-reactor membrane and MeTTa module. The membrane exposes typed raw contact read, stable hash, write-once native state/effect persistence, lifecycle persistence, and readback. A native idle promoter maps raw contacts through DObserve and CStep; only native-opportunity-transcribed may add SourceGroundedDevelopRNA. Its registered advancer moves that transcript to awaiting-authorized-generation and removes it from the ready set without executing the inert dispatch request.
consumer: The claim-bearing consumer is ReactorStart -> ReactorIdleOpportunity -> the new native promoter -> DObserve/DOpportunity/DDevelop/CStep -> a registered SourceGroundedDevelopRNA advancer. Prolog reads and persists terms already formed by MeTTa. JavaScript supplies disclosed JSON inputs, starts/stops isolated processes, and verifies durable/readback evidence; it never calls the cognitive functions or writes their products.
falsifiers: The runner invokes DObserve, DOpportunity, DDevelop, or CStep directly; the historical fixed proposal or InterestIdle participates; Prolog selects purpose or decides qualification; a qualifying contact fails to create one durable native state and inert effect request; any severed arm transcribes RNA; held reasons collapse; restart changes the persisted state/request, repeats the development decision, or replays waiting work; the reactor cannot return to readiness or stop explicitly; an effect request is executed; a model, credential, network, Chroma, Mattermost, private-memory, history-retrieval, or human-emission operation occurs; tests are weakened after observing source behavior; unrelated work changes; or a prior PASS supplies native standing.

cases.restored: Restoring qualifying independent source contact restores the durable undertaking; restarting its root preserves exact state/request bytes and produces no duplicate decision, transcript, or replay.
cases.held_out: Use the second R8 material family and one source-order variation; no arbitrary-language or general development claim follows.
cases.unknown_malformed: Malformed JSON/schema, foreign scope, unresolved native function, invalid lifecycle, storage conflict, integrity failure, process failure, timeout, and explicit stop remain distinct and fail without an external effect.
